notes.subject: aneggafa
notes.rationale: רעי d 'win yettḥebbin ɣef iguferen' — aneggafa (bu iguferen) d taqbaylit i win iḥekmen iguferen

notes.subject: Azmul n David
notes.rationale: ל can mean 'i David' (author) or 'i David' (dedication); 'n' chosen

notes.subject: d
notes.rationale: taqbaylit tesra tiferkit 'd' i tfelwit n usentel, taɛbranit ur ɣur-s ara

notes.subject: aneggafa-nneɣ
notes.rationale: asyifu amezwaru d iman-is; '-nneɣ' yettcudd ɣer yimeɣri

translation: Azmul n David. Yahwe d aneggafa-nneɣ; ur nettawi acemma.
